text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but repeated profit-taking in Stock B and C has not prevented the account from declining; I should judge each trade by its effect on the whole portfolio, not the realized gain.","My losses weigh heavily on me, so I should avoid letting that discomfort drive decisions. Use a consistent, forward-looking plan for holding or selling, rather than treating average cost as a reason to cling to a position.","Check diversification and risk across all holdings, and keep enough cash to respond to changing conditions instead of trading frequently just because I monitor the account every day."]}
